sources.notes: Feature tags are four-character identifiers; meaning and applicability remain client-dependent.
Pair positioning can implement kerning; class-based and contextual positioning can be more complex than simple pair tables.

assumptions: Presence in a FeatureList means the font defines the feature tag, not that it affects every script, language, glyph or variation instance.
licensing_data_restrictions: No user content is transmitted by normal tool execution. Third-party libraries retain their upstream licenses; font/PDF licensing remains the user’s responsibility.
uncertainty: The tool does not execute shaping or prove that enabling a tag is typographically appropriate. Prefer higher-level font-variant properties where suitable.
